subject: Request: Short runway extension & credit support while we unblock integration
messages:
From: Tanya Moore <tanya@solarisai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Li <marco@solarisai.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Short runway extension request — integration blocker

Hi Alex,

Quick context: we started the pilot with Redwood last week and hit a blocker in our connector build — the SDK auth exchange fails intermittently (getting 403 on token refresh). Our engineers have been triaging but it looks like an unexpected interaction with our proxy layer.

We’re committed to moving forward but this has stalled our e2e tests and demos for a scheduled exec review on Sep 10. Can you help with either (a) a short trial extension (2–3 weeks) or (b) temporary sandbox credits while we fix the proxy issue?

I’ve attached the integration-scan.log and a screenshot of the 403. Marco (cc’d) can share more traces if useful. We appreciate any runway so we don’t have to push the pilot timeline.

Thanks,
Tanya Moore
Senior Product Manager, SolarisAI
Attachments: integration-scan.log, screenshot-403.png
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Moore <tanya@solarisai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marco Li <marco@solarisai.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short runway extension request — integration blocker

Hi Tanya — thanks for the quick note and for the logs. Sorry to hear about the auth hiccup; Ben (copied) is our SE who can help triage the proxy/tokens flow.

Short answer: we can usually support a limited top-up of sandbox credits and extend the pilot window while you and Ben iterate on root cause. To speed this up I need to confirm two things with my manager: proposed extension length and how many credit units you’d need for the next 3 weeks.

Can you confirm: 1) would a 21-day extension cover your exec review on Sep 10? 2) estimate token usage for the next 3 weeks (rough ballpark is fine).

Ben — can you take a look at the logs Tanya attached and suggest next steps? I’ll pull together a short approval request once we have numbers.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0124
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Tanya Moore <tanya@solarisai.com>
Cc: Marco Li <marco@solarisai.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short runway extension request — integration blocker

Thanks Alex / Tanya — quick triage notes: the 403 looks like our token refresh endpoint is returning a 401 upstream when the proxy rewrites Authorization headers. Marco, can you confirm whether your proxy strips/rewrites headers for refresh calls? If so, a small config tweak should fix this. I can pair with your eng for 30 mins tomorrow.

Tanya: for runway planning, I’d recommend a 21-day extension plus a temporary sandbox credit of 10,000 gen-tokens to keep e2e testing smooth while we pair on the fix. That should cover demos and exploratory traffic.

Alex — I’m happy to document this as an SE request for approval.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: SolarisAI 21-day extension + 10k sandbox credits (RDW-8342-SOL)

Kimberly — forwarding a quick approval request for SolarisAI. Pilot is blocked by proxy/auth issue; SE recommends a short runway extension and a one-time sandbox credit to avoid slipping demo window.

Proposal:
- Extension: 21 days (pilot end date move from 2027-09-09 to 2027-09-30)
- Sandbox credits: 10,000 gen-tokens allocated to account for e2e tests and demos
- Terms: credits expire at end of extension; standard usage monitoring applies

Related docs: HubSpot deal RDW-8342-SOL (link below). I attached the logs and a short note from the customer.

Can you approve or suggest a different amount? Tina in CS usually applies credits once we have manager sign-off.

—Ben
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 10:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: SolarisAI 21-day extension + 10k sandbox credits (RDW-8342-SOL)

Thanks for the summary, Ben. Approved with one modification.

Approval: 21-day extension approved. Sandbox credit: approving 7,500 gen-tokens (one-time) instead of 10k — we can top up later if the team demonstrates clear need.

Please capture approval in HubSpot and attach a one-line approval note (I’ve added a brief PDF approval note to the thread). Lauren, can you work with CS (Tina) to apply the credits and update the pilot end date? Alex, please confirm with the customer and get DocuSign signature on the one-off trial credit agreement (template attached).

Approval-note.pdf attached.

—Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Moore <tanya@solarisai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marco Li <marco@solarisai.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short runway extension request — integration blocker

Hi Tanya — quick update: Kimberly approved a 21-day extension and a one-time 7,500 token sandbox credit to keep your test harness running. Lauren will apply the credits and update the pilot end date in HubSpot.

Next steps:
- Lauren will post the HubSpot update and notify CS to apply credits (you should see the applied credits within 24h).
- I’ll send a brief DocuSign (trial-credit-agreement.docx) for signature to confirm the one-off credit terms.
- Ben will schedule a 30-min pairing session with Marco to confirm the proxy headers (Ben, are you available tomorrow at 10am PT?).

Thanks again for the logs — Marco, Ben, and Tanya, loop on time for pairing and we’ll get this unstuck quickly.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: trial-credit-agreement.docx
